name: @prosopo/datasets-wasm
author: PROSOPO LIMITED <info@prosopo.io>

scripts.build:wasm: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=/cargo --remap-path-prefix=$(cd ../.. && pwd)=/captcha" cargo build -p prosopo-datasets-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && tsx rust/embed.ts ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/prosopo_datasets_wasm.wasm src/generated/module.ts

description: The image captcha commitment (the merkle root over the solution hashes), compiled from the provider's Rust to WebAssembly.
